title: An Introduction to Statistical Modeling of Extreme Values
relevance: Primary textbook on extreme value theory and GEV distribution fitting; provides the statistical methodology for modeling delay record distributions.

title: Statistics of Extremes
relevance: Advanced treatment of extremal statistics including tail estimation and return level computation; supports the cross-validation and prediction pipeline.

title: Delay records of the 3x+1 problem
relevance: Definitive source for the 131 known Collatz delay records that form the empirical dataset for GEV fitting and prediction.
